context: Dashboard fetches stats on mount and shows a loading indicator. In development with StrictMode, the component mounts twice. Users sometimes navigate away before data loads.
explanation: Removing the cancellation flag means if the user navigates away before fetchStats resolves, the .then callback calls setStats on an unmounted component — a no-op in React 18 but a real bug with any cleanup logic or follow-up renders. In StrictMode double-mount, the first (discarded) mount also applies stale data. Fix: keep the cancelled flag and check it before calling setStats.
